name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/ObservationShiftCalculation
description: Parameters to describe the observation shift for a daily compounded or averaged floating rate. This type is used to represent modular computed rates in interestRatePayouts.

additionalBusinessDays.description: Any additional business days that be applicable.

calculationBase.description: Whether the rate is calculated in advance, in arrears, or relative to a reset date.

offsetDays.description: The number of days of observation shift.
